info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Tremolit Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Tremolit Produce Detail Management API enables users to efficiently manage detailed records of Tremolit produce within the catalog. This API facilitates the creation of detailed entries that encompass essential attributes and specifications, enhancing inventory tracking and product classification. Typical consumers include supply chain managers and inventory coordinators looking to enrich their product databases. By standardizing the submission of Tremolit produce details, it streamlines operational workflows and improves data accuracy.

post.summary: Create a new tremolit produce detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail for the tremolit produce. It requires the appropriate request body that includes all necessary fields to define the produce detail. Ensure that all required data is provided to successfully create the resource.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the detailed information necessary for creating or updating a tremolit produce item. Ensure that all required fields are included and formatted correctly to avoid errors.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details returned.

tremolit_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the tremolit produce.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the tremolit produce.
